headline: Russian Cargo Vessel Stranded in Gulf of Finland Following Drone Strike
summary: A Russian cargo ship was left drifting in Finnish waters after being struck by two drones. The incident heightened security concerns across Baltic Sea maritime commercial routes.
why: The Baltic Sea is a critical commercial channel for bulk raw materials, containerized freight, and energy supplies between Europe and Nordic nations.

impacts.name: Baltic Maritime Shipping
impacts.why: Drone attacks on cargo vessels in Baltic waters increase maritime risk premiums and insurance rates.
